conditioning_provenance: Actual closed-loop neural rollout from original-conditioned gait windows. Planner selects targets; model does not receive scene geometry.
root_motion: MOTION owns scaled horizontal travel and heading; PELVIS residual; do not add navigation travel
contact_policy: >=0.65 maximum source heel/toe confidence; heuristic sole-center XY locking, broad-sole floor correction; unreviewed contacts
limitations: G1 and C08 proportions/rigs differ; this is measured adaptation, not reference-rig equivalence
No self-collision or physical balance guarantee
whole_avatar_ground_policy: Complete-avatar lift only, including non-foot armor support; no balance/contact solve
